title: Opinionatedly Optimized
description: A heavily opinionated but optimized modpack.
body:
**Opinionatedly Optimized** is a Fabric pack built for people who want maximum FPS but are tired of performance packs that leave the game looking and feeling empty.

It’s slightly opinionated, but you get a buttery-smooth experience AND a game that actually feels refreshing to play!

## 🔥 What's Inside?
- **Max performance** with Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore and Krypton so your gameplay feels good while keeping the refreshing visuals (see below)!

- **Refreshing visuals** with dynamic lights, 3D skin layers, wavy capes, and smooth menu animations that make UI transitions look incredibly satisfying :)

- **Quality of Life** changes like instant info on what you're looking at, exact food saturation, easy waypoints, and the best zoom mod (in my opinion ofc) with Jade, AppleSkin, wWaypoints, and Zoomify respectively.

- **Full integration** for builders with Litematica + Litematica Printer, Simple Voice Chat, and ViaFabricPlus so you can connect to literally any old Minecraft server version with a modern client.

> All of this, available on the latest version of Minecraft :D

> Of course, if you want this modpack for other versions, you can always [email me](https://mail.speedycoder1192.qzz.io/modrinth) and I will look into it as soon as I can.

> If you use this modpack, you are subject to this modpack's [license](https://gist.github.com/SpeedyCoder1192/c70f5abfdaf1847ba7e0ea8fe12d1322).
